notes.title: Regular update of game performance
notes.content:
Some optimizations have been made to the transition of the game interface
 Updated the visual performance of the selection interface
 Updated the visual performance of some items in the game to make it easier for you to distinguish
 Fixed some game defects

notes.title: 2021/2/25 Patch Update-Item Icon Update
notes.content:
Optimized the style of the clear item icon to facilitate the identification of the clear range of the clear item
 Updated the bug that the sound effect will not play normally
 Updated the use icons of ground detonation items that players can use to make it easier for players to identify
